recipe.upscale: wrapped separable Catmull-Rom, linear light, clamped to the source 2x2
recipe.sharpen: thresholded unsharp on linear luminance, clamped again
recipe.blockMean: each 4x4 block's mean restored to the source pixel it replaces, outermost output ring left alone
recipe.seamGuard: only if the finished 8-bit seam ratio exceeds 1.15x bilinear's, blend the outermost ring that far toward a plain wrapped bilinear
recipe.grain: wrapped value noise on the source grid, at most 3% of local luminance and 4/255 absolute, scaled by source 3x3 variance; off for sign/arrow/text, light, water/warp, sky and flat/black
